description: The OD-13 Regional Transport Office serves the coastal district of Puri in Odisha, a major religious and tourism hub. It is responsible for vehicle registration, issuing driving licenses, and enforcing road safety regulations across the district. The office plays a critical role in managing the heavy influx of tourist vehicles visiting the Jagannath Temple and the Puri beach.
address: Office of the Regional Transport Officer, Near Collectorate, Puri, Odisha
